reason: I've had a dry cough for three days and can't stop it.
diagnosis: Likely viral upper respiratory infection, with COVID-19 high on the differential, given the acute dry cough, feverish feeling, fatigue, myalgias, and household sick contact.
keyPoints: Onset, duration, and progression of cough
Dry vs productive cough, hemoptysis, and triggers
Associated infectious symptoms: fever, chills, myalgias, headache, sore throat, runny nose
COVID-specific symptoms and exposures: loss of taste/smell, sick contacts, household illness, work exposure
Red flags: shortness of breath, wheeze, chest pain, syncope, dehydration, inability to eat/drink
Past medical history and medications, especially thyroid disease and drug allergies
Smoking, alcohol, marijuana, and other respiratory risk factors
manner: worried, concerned about COVID, slightly tired from poor sleep
